profile.headline: Software Engineer | Developer | Expert in RESTful API, React, Java, Javascript Development | Scrum and Agile Methodologies | Engineering Excellence Award Recipient
profile.summary: Highly motivated and results-oriented software engineer with a strong background in research and development. Experienced in designing and implementing innovative solutions for complex systems. Skilled in data visualization, RESTful API development, system optimization, etc. Recognized for leading teams and driving improvements to enhance user experiences. Strong research abilities with a focus on data analysis and user studies. Committed to delivering high-quality results and exceeding expectations. Passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.locationName: Owings Mills, Maryland, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · React.js · Full-stack · Java · JavaScript · Spring Boot

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my role as a full-stack developer within a collaborative team of engineers, I leveraged my proficiency in an array of programming languages including Java, JavaScript, React, SQL, Python, among others, to engineer tailored software solutions that aligned precisely with clients' specifications. Moreover, I orchestrated the integration of various AWS services such as EC2, SQS, S3, and Lambda, to facilitate the development and deployment of cloud-based applications.
I utilized best practices for the continuous integration and deployment using tools such as Github, TravisCI, Artifactory, and Jenkins. In addition, I adeptly tackled challenges within Docker container environments, meticulously diagnosing and rectifying issues within the project's configuration to ensure the seamless integration of the latest modules.I understood unmaintained legacy codebases within the organization to diagnose and resolve issues related to incoming data, code functionality, and systematic concerns. Proactively addressing Chrome's impending policy changes on third-party cookies, I optimized internal application routing to uphold client satisfaction and align with evolving industry standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · Snowflake

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Coordinated the enhancement of a spatiotemporal coronavirus tracking system that allows users to visualize data on a map in the form of hollow concentric geocircles and improved the accuracy and relevance of the system by including vaccines administered and hospitalized data. Created a Python ETL to extract data from the Johns Hopkins COVID-19 GitHub repository, creating a robust database for seamless integration with a JavaScript front-end application. Drafted research papers for publication based on the system's effectiveness and its juxtaposition with other tracking systems through the results of user studies conducted over Zoom. Led efforts to develop and implement improvements to the system based on feedback from user studies, resulting in an enhanced user experience and increased usability.
Technologies Used: Python, JavaScript, JSON

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Created RESTful APIs to send data to RabbitMQ, a message broker that manages message exchange across microservices. Leveraged Java and Spring Boot’s capabilities to streamline code, creating modular and adaptable solutions. Engineered a user-friendly ReactJS interface, resulting in a 30% decrease in user input errors in test. Automated testing procedures by implementing unit and end-to-end tests ensuring an error-prone system. Developed an intuitive Splunk dashboard to monitor API metrics, employing advanced logging formats for accuracy.
Technologies Used: Java, Spring Boot, ReactJS, RabbitMQ, Splunk, Git, Mockito, Junit.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Java · REST APIs · React.js · Spring Boot

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I contributed to the Network Management System serving numerous enterprise customers around the globe to provide satellite internet connectivity. I developed and enhanced critical features on the system to improve customer accessibility, functionality, and efficiency.  Designed and developed PL/SQL data migration scripts to allow for backward compatibility among releases. I swiftly advanced to global on-call support within months, demonstrating adaptability and value to the team. I provided assistance to more than 10 enterprise clients during a significant version upgrade, resulting in minimal system downtime. I rapidly identified and resolved outages during on-call, quickly addressing production issues and escalating as needed. In the last few months, I optimized queries, database interactions, and various functions in the system to efficiently process customers with large systems. Along with development, I diagnosed serval critical issues and supported live customer networks worldwide. I received Engineering Excellence Award (2020), over fellow new hires (30+ people) for my efforts.
Technologies Used: Java, JavaScript, Oracle SQL, Angular, Groovy/Grails, Agile, Hibernate, PLSQL.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Full-stack · REST APIs · PL/SQL · Front-End Development

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: I coded functioning UI in Android Studio using UI/UX designs sketched in Adobe XD. I designed and connected a database using Google’s Firebase to store, retrieve, and update data that is then displayed on the app.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: In the summer of 2018, I worked as an undergraduate teaching assistant for the Data Structures and Algorithms class. I collaborated with a professor and other teaching assistants to prepare materials for labs and projects. I also mentored students in the lab sections to reinforce key learning concepts and help complete assignments.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Contributed to backend and frontend design work of the MySatsang application used by over 5K users. •	Analyzed the current system and drafted detailed design documents for a more dynamic application using a content management system (CMS). Troubleshootted issues users faced, added features, and communicated with stakeholders to set application requirements.
Technologies Used: Java, Spring Boot, Docker, AWS, PostgreSQL.

projects.title: ScrollyTelling
projects.description: Created an application that brought life to time-series data uploaded by the user, with an interactive article. Leveraged D3 JS to provide interactive visuals, and Python to process the data, in a React-JS application.

projects.title: Get Clicked
projects.description:
We engineered a Web Application with a group of 3 individuals where instructors can create questions and students can answer them. I constructed the HTML and CSS of each page while understanding the
communication between the server and the client.

publications.title: MiniStat LL: A Wearable, Open Source Potentiostat for Research and Educational Purposes

organizations.name: Purdue Mind
organizations.description: I helped research and brainstorm idea to resolve prevalent medical issues. I assisted programming team to create a stroke rehabilitation glove. We were finalists for BMES 2016/2017 and won $5k in a global Intel sponsored competition
